Each Map<T>(string, IReadOnlyList<CsvColumnMap>?) call names a concrete type generically, so the mapping and its per-type CsvColumnMaps are resolved with the property metadata trimming/AOT needs preserved. CsvDiscriminator<TBase> Describes how a single CSV file mixes multiple record shapes, keyed by a discriminator column, so a CsvExtractor<TRecord> binds each row to the right concrete type and a CsvLoader<TRecord> writes each record's type and columns. Build one with CsvDiscriminatorBuilder<TBase> — that path is trim/AOT-safe. Constructing it directly from a Mapping dictionary is supported but reflects over the mapped types at run time. CsvLoader<TRecord> Loads records of type TRecord into a CSV stream using CsvHelper. CsvReadingExceptionInfo Describes a recoverable parse exception encountered while reading a CSV stream. Surfaced to the caller via ReadingExceptionOccurred so logging, metrics, or quarantine logic can be plugged in without the library making logging decisions on the caller's behalf. CsvShouldQuoteContext Provides per-field context to a ShouldQuote callback while writing a CSV stream. CsvValidationException Thrown when a record fails validation and OnValidationFailure is Stop. Carries the source line and the aggregated failure reasons. CsvValidationResult The outcome of running a CsvValidator<T> against a record: whether it passed and, if not, the human-readable reasons it failed. CsvValidator Factory methods for the common built-in CsvValidator<T> rules. Each takes a selector that reads the member under test, so the rules stay strongly typed without reflection.
